verdict.rationale: File converters can plausibly expose an API, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found all candidate OpenAPI and Swagger paths returning 404. The documented CLI with `--json` output is a different capability and earns no credit toward a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
